description:
Calculate the estimated time to charge a 200 Ah battery using a 25 A charger using the Electrical Engineering Calculations app.

Your goal is to:
1. Open the 'Battery Charging Time' calculator (usually under 'Battery' section).
2. Enter Battery Capacity: 200 Ah.
3. Enter Charging Current: 25 A.
4. If asked for efficiency or type, use Lead Acid / 85% (or default).
5. Calculate the time.
6. Save the numerical result (in hours, e.g., '9.4') to a text file at '/sdcard/tasks/charge_time_result.txt'.
7. Take a screenshot of the result screen and save it to '/sdcard/tasks/charge_time_screenshot.png'.
